exposure: Gestational age at birth (early term vs. other term)
cohort: Term infants admitted to the NICU at New York University Langone Medical Center over a 17 month period
finding: Early-term infants (37-37 6/7 weeks gestation) were at increased risk of NICU admission, respiratory distress syndrome, and hypoglycemia compared to infants born at 38 weeks or later.
mod_finding: Early-term neonates were more likely to be born via elective cesarean section than other term neonates.
